name: Slime Factory Tycoon
tagline: Tap, automate, rebirth — an idle slime empire built to last.
description: An open-source Roblox idle-tycoon built as a production-grade foundation rather than a prototype. Tap the vat to earn Goo, automate production, unlock factory zones, and rebirth for permanent multipliers. Under the hood it's a modular service architecture with a declarative networking layer, session-locked saves, idempotent purchase handling, and a CI balance simulator that plays the game on every commit.
statusDetail: Core systems complete and testable in Roblox Studio. Not yet published to Roblox.

features.title: Modular service architecture
features.desc: Auto-discovered services with an explicit init/start/player lifecycle. New systems drop in without editing bootstrap code.

features.title: Declarative networking
features.desc: Every remote is declared with its validator and rate limit in one table, so validation can't be forgotten and remote names can't be typo'd.

features.title: Session-locked saves
features.desc: Atomic UpdateAsync locking prevents the cross-server duplication that plagues idle games, with autosave, retry backoff, and shutdown handling.

features.title: Idempotent purchases
features.desc: ProcessReceipt keyed by PurchaseId with save-before-confirm and rollback, so players are never double-charged or charged for nothing.

features.title: Achievement framework
features.desc: 16 stat-driven achievements that unlock automatically. Bump a stat anywhere and the system works out what it completed.

features.title: Cosmetics, never pay-to-win
features.desc: 15 cosmetics across vat skins, goo colours, trails and titles. The cosmetic service has no access to the economy multiplier by design.

features.title: Accessibility first
features.desc: Reduced motion, high contrast, 80-150% text scale, and colour-blind modes persist server-side and follow the player across devices.

features.title: CI balance simulator
features.desc: A dependency-free Python model plays the game on every commit and fails the build if progression drifts into churn territory.

changelog.title: Architecture & brand foundation
changes: Refactored to an auto-discovering service registry with init/start/player lifecycle
Added declarative Net layer: per-remote validators and rate limits in one table
Added Validate module rejecting NaN, infinity, oversized strings and type confusion
Added achievement system with 16 stat-driven unlocks and automatic reward granting
Added cosmetic framework with 15 items, structurally unable to affect gameplay balance
Added generic inventory framework with ownership verification and save-size pruning
Added server-persisted settings with reduced motion, high contrast, text scale and colour-blind modes
Added pooled procedural audio engine with pentatonic tap combo pitching
Added themed UI component library with 44px minimum touch targets
Established visual identity: logo, icon set, banner, and full brand guidelines

changelog.title: Automation
changes: Added Rojo project for live Studio sync
Added CI workflow: lint, balance check, and place-file build artifact
Added dependency-free Python balance simulator with CI gating
Added promo code system with server-side validation
Rebalanced rebirth cost after the simulator found first rebirth at 33 minutes, past the churn point

changelog.title: Initial foundation
changes: Core tap-to-earn loop with client prediction and batched remotes
Five upgrades, six factory zones, rebirth prestige
Pet hatching with server-side RNG and published odds
Offline earnings, seven-day daily streak, global leaderboards
Session-locked DataStore persistence and idempotent receipt handling

roadmap.item: Final art pass on pets and zones

stats.$comment: Code metrics only. No player counts, visits, ratings or revenue figures are recorded here because the game is unpublished and any such number would be fabricated.
